business_case.pitch: At illustrative 90 new homes/week and eight weeks in process, 720 cases overlap. Half using self-service with 65% of their routine contacts avoided could release about 15 staff-hours/week after review, reconciliation, support and new-intake onboarding. This is a testable capacity scenario, not observed savings; the low scenario loses about two hours/week.
